WITH base AS (
  SELECT DATE, SourceCommonName, DocumentIdentifier, V2Tone,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(Extras, r'<PAGE_TITLE>(.*?)</PAGE_TITLE>') AS title
  FROM `gdelt-bq.gdeltv2.gkg_partitioned`
  WHERE _PARTITIONTIME >= TIMESTAMP('2020-08-31')
    AND _PARTITIONTIME < TIMESTAMP('2021-01-02')
    AND DATE >= 20200901000000 AND DATE < 20210101000000
    AND (TranslationInfo IS NULL OR TranslationInfo = '')
), normed AS (
  SELECT *, CONCAT(' ', TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(
    LOWER(CONCAT(IFNULL(title, ''), ' ', IFNULL(DocumentIdentifier, ''))), r'[^a-z0-9]+', ' ')), ' ') AS t
  FROM base
), tagged AS (
  SELECT * EXCEPT (t), ARRAY(SELECT k FROM UNNEST([
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' bitcoins? '), 'bitcoin', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' btc '), 'btc', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' cryptos? '), 'crypto', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' cryptocurrenc(?:y|ies) '), 'cryptocurrency', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' stablecoins? '), 'stablecoin', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' tether '), 'tether', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' binance '), 'binance', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' coinbase '), 'coinbase', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' spot (?:bitcoin |btc |ether |ethereum |crypto )?etfs? '), 'spot_etf', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' federal reserve '), 'federal_reserve', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' fomc '), 'fomc', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' cpi '), 'cpi', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' inflation '), 'inflation', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' interest rates? '), 'interest_rate', NULL),
      IF(REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' sec ') AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(t, r' (?:bitcoins?|cryptos?|cryptocurrenc(?:y|ies)) '), 'sec_crypto', NULL)
    ]) AS k WHERE k IS NOT NULL) AS keywords
  FROM normed
)
SELECT * FROM tagged WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(keywords) > 0
